lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li12Cu4 (reduced formula Li3Cu) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group P4/nmm (No. 38), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Cu centers with 12 Li neighbors in a close-packed-like local arrangement, while Li centers display 12-neighbor environments, including close-packed-like and body-centered-cubic-like motifs. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and spans all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Li-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing between Cu- and Li-centered polyhedra.
